title: PanKbase Team to Present Latest Advances at HIRN Annual Investigators Meeting
bodyHtml:
The upcoming Human Islet Research Network (HIRN) 10th Annual Investigators Meeting will focus on the state of diabetes research and future directions for T1D research, as well as advances in islet and pancreas research. Attendees can look forward to the following featured talks from the PanKbase team.  

“Platform Discussion & Demonstration: dkNET and PanKbase,” led by Noel Burtt from the Broad Institute and Shuibing Chen from Weill Cornell Medical College. This session will showcase the capabilities of both platforms, giving investigators a hands-on look at the tools and resources available for diabetes and pancreas research.

Additional feature presentation include

"An Interactive Resource to Generate and Provide Integrated Knowledge of the Human Pancreas" by Kyle Gaulton, University of California, San Diego 

"PanKbase: A Community Hub for Integrated Pancreas Knowledge" by Stephen Parker, University of Michigan

To learn more, read more at here.
summary: The Human Islet Research Network (HIRN) Annual Investigators Meeting will feature a variety of presentations, including talks from the PanKbase team, who will share their latest research and insights. The meeting offers an opportunity for investigators across the network to connect, discuss new developments, and foster collaborations in the field of islet biology and diabetes research.
